title: [3.0.0] CGM Eversense integration does not work
symptom: BG reading from Eversense does not work in AAPS 3.0.0. For older versions, it worked with patched ES apk -> ESEL -> MM640g in AAPS. But this does not work with the new AAPS version. The BG values are simply not available.
